title: Snake
description: Steer the snake with the arrow keys and eat apples. It grows with every apple. Touching the wall or yourself ends the game.

tasks.text: Start with Run and eat an apple (arrow keys; the world has to be clicked).
Make the snake faster: Kopf.act moves it only every 8 frames – change the number.
Select the head in the class diagram and call a method from the menu.
Add a class Goldapfel that gives three points.

tasks: Let the snake come out on the other side of the wall instead of losing.
